6107.title: Pooled Codex provider identity cannot be resolved by a clean client
6107.rootCauseOneLine: Pooled launches persist a custom provider identity defined only by process-local overrides; clean clients cannot resolve it.
6107.proposedFix: Preserve a portable identity for new sessions without changing pool routing or authentication, then define explicit compatibility for already-saved sessions.
6107.caveats: Linux Codex 0.159.0 only; no desktop GUI or live authentication tested. Omitting the provider also fails on this version. Existing-session remediation exceeds the automatic simple-fix gate. Full reproduction test is inline; public repo policy excludes separate test artifacts.
